attchmntText: India Glycols Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: India Glycols Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 during a Board Meeting held on 13th November 2026. The company reported a profit before tax of 15.25 Crores for the quarter and 31.79 Crores for the half year. Revenue from operations stood at 358.18 Crores for the quarter and 712.82 Crores for the half year. Earnings per share were 1.68 Rupees for the quarter and 3.52 Rupees for the half year. The financial results include a Limited Review Report by Statutory Auditors. The Board Meeting commenced at 16:18 Hrs and concluded at 17:15 Hrs. The results reflect the demerger of Spirits and Biofuel Undertaking and Biopharma Undertaking effective 1st April 2026. Comparative figures for previous periods are restated to exclude these demerged entities.

attchmntText: India Glycols Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management
voiceSummary: India Glycols Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved the re-appointment of Shri Alok Singhal, DIN 10359043, as an Executive Director and whole time director on 13th November 2026. The appointment is for a term of 3 years, effective from 1st December 2026 to 30th November 2029. This action is subject to the approval of the members of the company. Shri Singhal is not debarred from holding the office of director. The board meeting commenced at 16:18 Hrs and concluded at 17:15 Hrs.

attchmntText: India Glycols Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: India Glycols Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board meeting was held on 13th November 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 358.18 Crores for the quarter and 712.82 Crores for the half year. Profit before tax was 15.25 Crores for the quarter and 31.79 Crores for the half year. Basic earnings per share was 1.68 Rupees for the quarter and 3.52 Rupees for the half year. The company demerged its Spirits, Biofuel, and Biopharma undertakings effective 1st April 2026. Comparative figures for the previous year include these demerged entities. The financial results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board. Statutory auditors conducted a limited review of the results.
